meta.title: AI employees for real work
meta.description: Hire AI employees with a role, a personality and your company's context. They answer clients, do scheduled work, and stop for your approval before anything goes public.

hero.eyebrow: For small teams with big to-do lists
hero.headline: Hire an AI employee. Give it a job. Keep the final say.
hero.subhead: Desker turns a job description and your documents into an agent that answers your clients, researches, drafts and follows up on a schedule - and asks you before anything is published or sent.
hero.note: Free to start. No credit card. The first agent takes about five minutes.

steps.title: Describe the role
steps.body: Pick a template - support, marketing, research, admin - then give it a name, a tone of voice and a plain-language rule for when to fetch a human.

steps.title: Give it your context
steps.body: Upload the policies, price lists and FAQs it should know. It answers from those and cites them, instead of guessing.

steps.title: Test, publish, delegate
steps.body: Talk to it live before anyone else does. Publish it as a chat link or a widget on your site. Give it a scope of work and a schedule, and review what it produces from your inbox.

trust.heading: Built so you can trust it with your business

points.title: A human sign-off, always
points.body: Publishing a post or sending an email waits for your approval. You can loosen that per agent, per tool, once it has earned it.

points.title: Sources, not guesses
points.body: Answers come from your documents and cited web research. When it doesn't know, it says so.

points.title: A complete trail
points.body: Every tool call, every approval, every schedule - who did what, when, and why - queryable and exportable.

points.title: Your data stays yours
points.body: Integration credentials are encrypted at rest. Nothing you upload trains anyone's model.

pricing.heading: Simple pricing
pricing.intro: Priced on what actually costs money: how many agents are live and how much they do each month. Start free; upgrade when an agent is earning its keep.
pricing.footnote: All plans include every role, unlimited teammates, the audit log and email support.

cta.heading: Put your first agent to work today
cta.body: Five minutes to a working agent. Free to start.
